address: 100 boulevard de la République, La Garenne-Colombes, 92250, France
bio: This local bistro serves wholesome, updated, tasty fare, in the shape of a menu devised by chef Bordier, whose illustrious career speaks for itself. Diners dig into good food in a friendly relaxed venue, washed down with a selection from the concise wine list, which showcases wine - producing women....
